# How to cite {.unnumbered}

```{r}
#| results: "asis"
#| echo: false
source("../_common.R")
```

If you use `SCpubr` in your research, please cite:

```
Blanco-Carmona, E. Generating publication ready visualizations 
for Single Cell transcriptomics using SCpubr. bioRxiv (2022) 
doi:10.1101/2022.02.28.482303.
```

## BibTeX entry

```bibtex
@article{blanco2022scpubr,
  title={Generating publication ready visualizations for Single Cell transcriptomics using SCpubr},
  author={Blanco-Carmona, Enrique},
  journal={bioRxiv},
  year={2022},
  doi={10.1101/2022.02.28.482303}
}
```

## Package version

You can get the package version and citation in R:

```{r}
#| eval: false
citation("SCpubr")
packageVersion("SCpubr")
```
